title: Final Compression / Bet Construction Gate
question: When full HAD/HHAD/TTG/CRS distributions preserve a meaningful secondary result branch, does final ticket compression silently delete it, and do protection labels map to the result space they claim to protect?
hypotheses: A single-HAD-result final action is structurally riskier when CRS Top-5 already contains an alternate HAD-result state and HHAD is directionally non-confirming.
Bet-construction semantic type checks can prevent false 'protection' claims such as home -1 HHAD H+D being described as protection against an ordinary draw.
deterministic_invariants: For home -1, HHAD_H + HHAD_D covers only ordinary HAD_H at result level; it does not cover HAD_D.
For home +1, HHAD_H covers ordinary HAD_H or HAD_D at result level.
Full distributions are audited before final compression; no TTG/CRS early truncation is reintroduced.

falsification_contract.promotion_requires: Strict pre-match frozen OOS/walk-forward comparison at matched ticket cost/selection count.
primary_metrics: realized HAD branch coverage at matched selection cost
ROI and max drawdown after execution ledger maturity
reject_or_keep_shadow_if: OOS coverage improvement disappears after matching ticket cost
alerts mostly expand selections without improving high-confidence error rate or drawdown
benefit is confined to one league/time window
falsification_contract.semantic_type_checks: Deterministic correctness checks may be enforced as audit warnings without claiming predictive lift; production ticket changes still require explicit approval.
